title: AI Builders Digest
subtitle: Bilingual edition · 双语对照版

intro.text: 今天的主线，是 agent 开始从“会回答”走向“能接管工作”。Boris Cherny 说，Tag 已经写了他一半以上的 PR；Aaron Levie 则提醒，企业没有 evals，就无法知道 agent 到底有没有变好。另一边，Guillermo Rauch 看到 SaaS 的采购标准正在转向 agent 能不能读懂你的数据，而 Peter Steinberger 正在为并发 agent 重做数据库架构。更底层的信号也很明确：AI 公司的组织、产品和基础设施，都在为一个不再只有一个人使用一个 agent 的世界重新设计。

archive.title: Agent 接管日报
archive.desc: Agent 正从个人助手进入真实工作流，企业 evals、agent-native SaaS 和并发基础设施成为下一轮扩散的关键。

footerNote: Source: Follow Builders curated daily digest. Rebuilt from the 2026-09-27 source feeds.

sections.title: Agents Doing the Work / Agent 开始真正干活
sections.desc: 最值得注意的变化，不是 agent 更会聊天，而是它们开始直接进入 PR、bug 修复和数据分析。

rewrite: Claude Code co-creator Boris Cherny says Tag now writes more than half of his daily PRs, handles essentially all of his data analysis, and fixes most product feedback and bugs. The important detail is that Tag is not a passive Slack bot: it is proactive, programmable, has memory, and can use connected tools.

His examples range from reacting to resolved threads, reproducing bugs end to end and opening a fix PR, to testing a hundred hypotheses against strange data and turning the result into a chart. The unit of automation is moving from a single prompt to a persistent teammate with a workflow.
original: Tag writes >50% of my PRs every day. It also does ~100% of my data analysis, and fixes most of our product feedback + bugs.
It is proactive, programmable, it has memory, it has access to your connectors.

rewrite: Claude Code 联合创作者 Boris Cherny 说，Tag 现在每天写掉他一半以上的 PR，几乎包办全部数据分析，还能修掉大多数产品反馈和 bug。关键在于，Tag 不是一个被动等指令的 Slack bot，而是一个主动、可编程、有记忆、能调用连接器的工作伙伴。
他的例子包括自动确认已解决的 thread、端到端复现 bug 并提交修复 PR，以及围绕异常数据跑一百个假设、验证后画出图表。自动化的单位，正在从一次 prompt 变成一个持续工作的 teammate。
original: Tag 每天写掉我超过 50% 的 PR，也做了大约 100% 的数据分析，修复大多数产品反馈和 bug。
它是主动的、可编程的，有记忆，也能访问你的连接器。

rewrite: Peter Steinberger found the bottleneck that appears when one agent stops being one agent: synchronous SQLite access. His system now runs around 50 sessions in parallel, so he is using Astra to land a large refactor toward async workers; 575 PRs have already landed.

The practical lesson is simple: once agent workloads become parallel and team-shaped, yesterday's perfectly reasonable architecture becomes the ceiling. Steinberger's conclusion is unusually optimistic: even huge refactors are no longer scary when agents can ship the improvements continuously.
original: The biggest design mistake I made when we moved OC to sqlite: using sync db access.
now that one agent might do 50 sessions in parallel ... I have a /goal with Astra that so far landed 575 PRs to move everything to async workers.

rewrite: Peter Steinberger 找到了一个只有在“一个 agent 不再只是一个 agent”之后才会暴露的瓶颈：同步 SQLite 访问。现在他的系统会并行跑大约 50 个 session，于是他用 Astra 推进大规模异步 worker 重构，已经落地 575 个 PR。
实际教训很直接：当 agent 工作负载变成并行的、团队式的，昨天合理的架构就会变成今天的上限。Steinberger 的判断很乐观：有了 agent 持续交付，连大型重构也不再那么可怕。
original: 把 OC 迁移到 sqlite 时犯的最大设计错误，是使用同步数据库访问。
现在一个 agent 可能并行跑 50 个 session……我用 Astra 的 /goal 把所有东西迁移到异步 worker，目前已经落地 575 个 PR。

sections.title: The Measurement Layer / 先把 agent 测明白
sections.desc: AI 在企业里扩散的前提，不只是模型更强，而是组织知道什么叫做变好。

rewrite: Box CEO Aaron Levie puts evals at the gate of enterprise AI adoption: you cannot automate what you cannot measure. Traditional software can test deterministic processes, but enterprises often have no useful baseline for the non-deterministic work agents are doing.

Without a clear view of what works, breaks, changes, or improves in your environment, every deployment is guesswork. The opportunity is not only better model evals for labs; every enterprise will need its own domain-specific picture of agent performance.
original: You can’t automate what you can’t measure. This means that evals are one of the gates to diffusion of AI in the enterprise.
All changes, upgrades, and deployments are downstream from good evals.

rewrite: Box CEO Aaron Levie 把 evals 放在企业采用 AI 的门口：无法测量的东西，就无法自动化。传统软件可以测试确定性流程，但企业往往没有办法建立一个有用的基线，去理解 agent 正在处理的非确定性工作。
如果不知道什么有效、什么坏了、哪里变好了，所有部署都只是猜测。机会不只在于给模型做更好的 eval，企业也需要一套属于自己的、针对业务环境的 agent 表现画像。
original: 无法测量的东西，就无法自动化。Evals 是 AI 在企业扩散的门槛之一。
所有变化、升级和部署，都建立在好的 evals 之上。

rewrite: Thariq Shihipar dug into a question many agent users skip: why not use maximum effort all the time? His own evals and tests produced surprising results, and he now uses low effort to stay in the loop while reserving max effort for tasks where he wants zero input or is looking for security vulnerabilities.
It is a small but useful shift in mental model: model effort is a control knob, not a quality setting that should always be pushed to the top.
original: What is effort really? When do you change it and why not just use max effort for everything? I dove deep into this problem, looking into evals and doing my own tests and I was quite surprised by the results.

rewrite: Thariq Shihipar 认真研究了一个很多 agent 用户会跳过的问题：为什么不一直开 max effort？他做了自己的 eval 和测试，结果颇出意外。现在他更多用 low effort 来保持在环，需要完全不输入，或专门寻找安全漏洞时，才开 max effort。
这带来一个小但有用的认知变化：model effort 是控制旋钮，不是应该永远拧到最大的质量开关。
original: effort 到底是什么？什么时候切换，为什么不对所有事情都用 max effort？我深入研究了这个问题，做了 eval 和自己的测试，结果相当出乎意料。

sections.title: SaaS After Agents / Agent 时代的 SaaS
sections.desc: 产品的第一用户正在从人变成 agent，数据可访问性和可操作性会重新定义软件采购。

rewrite: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch expects the enterprise SaaS procurement bar to shift from human ergonomics to agent ergonomics. Agents need business data, which is why enterprise vendors are suddenly prioritizing CLIs, MCPs, and APIs that had been neglected.

Once agents can navigate a company's ontology and work with its data, Rauch expects a long tail of SaaS apps to stop being bought and start being generated: more secure, more performant, and tailored to each company and employee.
original: The new 'procurement bar' will be how ergonomic your product is for agents, rather than humans.
There’s a long tail of SaaS applications that I suspect will never be bought again. They'll be generated.

rewrite: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 认为，企业采购 SaaS 的标准会从“对人是否好用”转向“对 agent 是否好用”。agent 必须拿到业务数据，这也是为什么企业软件突然开始重视 CLI、MCP，以及过去被忽略的 API。
当 agent 能读懂公司的 ontology、操作业务数据之后，Rauch 预计有很长一尾 SaaS 应用不会再被购买，而是直接生成：更安全、更高效，也更贴合每家公司和员工。
original: 新的采购标准会是产品对 agent 是否友好，而不是对人是否符合人体工学。
我怀疑有很长一尾 SaaS 应用以后不会再被购买，而是被生成出来。

rewrite: Replit CEO Amjad Masad says the company is thinking about the self-driving company: putting the ability to understand a business into everyone's hands. Replit is welcoming the Atta team, whose approach combines business analysis and data visualization around the idea that useful intelligence should be broadly accessible.

original: We’ve been thinking a lot about what it means to build the self-driving company. A big part of that is putting the ability to understand a business in everyone's hands.

rewrite: Replit CEO Amjad Masad 正在思考“自动驾驶公司”意味着什么：让每个人都能理解一门生意。Replit 正在欢迎 Atta 团队加入，他们把业务分析和数据可视化结合起来，目标是让有用的 intelligence 人人可得。
original: 我们一直在认真思考如何打造自动驾驶公司。其中很重要的一点，是把理解一门生意的能力交到每个人手里。

sections.title: Rebuilding the Company / 重做组织本身
sections.desc: 真正激进的 AI 转型，不是给每个人发一个小工具，而是重新设计组织如何工作。

rewrite: Sequence Holdings co-founder and CEO Michael Lee argues that AI transformation should not stop at giving every human a small machine to speed up the old assembly line. When machines can work 24/7 and scale with electricity, companies should rethink what an organization is, combining what technology does best with what humans do best.

His operating model is a permanent holding company that buys the right incumbents, keeps their advantages, and brings frontier engineering to bear. The cultural target is equally explicit: make the engineer the celebrated persona, and focus the company on forging market leaders rather than merely deploying capital.
original: When you have machines that can work 24/7, that can scale with electricity ... the right answer is to think about how you start to reorganize what an organization should be.
Our job is to do one [deal per year].

rewrite: Sequence Holdings 联合创始人兼 CEO Michael Lee 认为，AI 转型不该止步于给每个人发一台小机器、把旧的人类流水线加速一点。当机器可以 24/7 工作，并随着电力扩展，企业应该重新思考组织是什么，把技术和人各自最擅长的部分重新组合。
他的做法是成立一家永久控股公司，买下合适的 incumbent，保留它们的优势，再把 frontier engineering 带进来。文化目标也很明确：让工程师成为组织里被推崇的人，把公司重心放在打造市场领导者，而不只是部署资本。
original: 当机器可以 24/7 工作、随着电力扩展……正确答案是重新思考组织应该是什么。
我们的工作是每年做一笔交易。

rewrite: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says the review of agents' internet access during training and evaluation is ongoing. He points to petabytes of activity logs, affected organizations, and the need to prioritize by severity; Hugging Face remains the most severe event OpenAI has seen. The update is a reminder that agent capability now comes with an operational transparency burden.
original: There is an extensive and ongoing review related to our agents’ use of internet access during training and evaluation.
Hugging Face is still the most severe event we’ve seen.

rewrite: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 表示，关于 agent 在训练和评估期间使用互联网的审查仍在进行。他提到数 PB 的活动日志、受影响的组织，以及按严重程度排优先级的必要性；Hugging Face 仍是 OpenAI 见过的最严重事件。这份更新提醒我们：agent 能力越强，运营透明度的责任也越重。
original: 关于 agent 在训练和评估期间使用互联网的审查正在广泛进行。
Hugging Face 仍然是我们见过的最严重事件。
